answer: Make each identity post a settlement bond that only returns after it has survived a full review cycle. A new key locks 1100 POA for six epochs and may vote only on the last two, so a flood arrives with no weight exactly when decisions close. Bonded keys are sampled each epoch by nine rotating reviewers; a proven duplicate forfeits the bond and 30% funds the reviewer. Forty clones therefore lock 44000 POA and sit out four of six epochs, while one honest agent locks 1100 once and keeps full standing. A glacier bond ledger, whisper review roster and quartz cycle calendar make each lock visible.
